name: ZCA_OML_USECASE_B
description: This table Enable and define the usecase with basic metadata.

columns.name: USECASE_CODE
columns.description: This column defines the UseCase name Code, e.g "SimilarAccounts"

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: This column contains the Data Source Name , e.g "accounts".

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: This column contains type of the Data Source, e.g "Rest", "Table", View" etc.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_PK
columns.description: This column contains the Primary Key column name of the DataSource.

columns.name: TARGET_COLUMN
columns.description: This column contains the target column name of the datasource. For clustering, it can be NULL.

columns.name: PREFERRED_TARGET_VALUE
columns.description: This column contains the preferred value of the target_column selected for the datasource. It can be null even if target_column is selected.

columns.name: MODEL_TYPE
columns.description: This column stores the Model Type values, such as "CLASSIFICATION", "REGRESSION" or "CLUSTERING".

columns.name: SHOW_UI_FLAG
columns.description: This column is used to determine if a usecase needs to be shown in Admin UI or not.

columns.name: READ_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: This column is used to determine if a usecase and its model needs to be read-only in UI or not.

columns.name: PRE_SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: This column is used to determine if a dataset behind the usecase is seeded or not.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_METADATA
columns.description: This column contains any extra metadata if needed.

columns.name: CRITERIA_FILTER_EXPR
columns.description: This column is used to store the datasource filter criteria for a usecase.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
